verdict.rationale: Slack documents a broad Web API for querying and changing a workspace, with more than 200 methods, an official OpenAPI spec, an Events API, and an MCP server covering messages, canvases, users, files and lists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and UI features such as huddles and AI recaps have no evidenced API equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of huddles and Slack AI features, and independent hands-on verification of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Slack Web API is an interface for querying information from and enacting change in a Slack workspace.
Send data to or query data from Slack using any of more than 200 methods.
The Slack MCP server provides tools for searching through Slack, retrieving and sending messages, managing canvases, managing users, uploading files, and working with lists.
AI agents can now read, write, and manage your Slack Lists directly.
